meta.note: Protected terms (PRD: Simpler Filipino and English, Section 2). These words are part of what Taympers teaches: never reworded, respelled, shortened or translated, in Filipino or English. A rewrite changes only the words around them. English may add a short meaning in brackets after the first one on a screen, e.g. "Agimat (lucky charm)", never in its place. The team leader checks this list before Phase 1; add new terms here, and the checks read them from this file.
